root_cause_hypothesis: Pattern-matching bug in discover-bctc-urls-browser.py:matches_quarter_and_year(). The function looks for 'quý 1', 'quý 2', etc. (without leading zero), but SSC NewsSearch returns 'quý 01', 'quý 02', etc. (with leading zero). This causes ALL matches to fail at the validation step, even though the discovery source (SSC Playwright) finds the correct row. Result: zero PDFs fetched from ANY ticker for Q1/2026.
root_cause_evidence: Pattern list includes: ['q1', 'quý 1', 'quy 1', 'kỳ 1', ...] — all without leading zero
SSC rows consistently show 'quý 01' format in test runs

matches_quarter_and_year('báo cáo tài chính hợp nhất quý 1 năm 2026', 'Q1', 2026) → True (would work if source used this format)
